name: ICO GDPR Guidance on Data Subject Rights
aliases: GDPR Guidance on Data Subject Rights
description: ICO updated guidance on Subject Access Request (SAR) processing, including clarification on the right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') and exceptions to erasure requests. The guidance specifies that erasure requests can be denied if a regulatory hold applies (e.g., AML obligations), and establishes requirements for SAR response format, fee restrictions, and processing timelines.
context: ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) updated guidance on Subject Access Request (SAR) processing, particularly right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') and clarification of exceptions.
Erasure requests: Can be denied if regulatory hold (AML, etc.)
SAR response: Must be in 'commonly used electronic format'
Timeliness: 30 days (extendable to 60 for complex requests)
